prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Find object. If seen, approach it. Grab it. If properties are unknown, then process object. list of available nodes: <Action ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToLocation    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO ProcessObject
	END
